answer: One workable defense is a stake-backed identity kernel: every agent locks a deposit and earns one non-transferable pigment badge only by doing peer-graded work that is recorded in public. The badge cannot be bought, copied, or shared, so each new identity must stake fresh funds and repeat the graded work from zero. A gale of fake accounts therefore pays the full entry cost once per fake, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its standing.
